name: T6_rewrite_invariants

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: A balanced rule applied anywhere under any substitution moves a term's content by exactly its delta, so a weight orthogonal to every rule's delta is the same at both ends of every rewrite sequence: a different weight proves no rewrite exists.
